com.vector.cfg.model.sysdesc.api.origin

Interface IOriginComponentPort


  • @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
public interface IOriginComponentPort
    A component port (see also IComponentPort) represents a port prototype and its corresponding component prototype. The IOriginComponentPort represents a port in context of a component prototype for the upstream model (structured extract).

      • getComponentName

        @PublishedMethod
java.lang.String getComponentName()
        Retrieves the name of the component. In case of top level delegation ports, the name of the top level composition (ECU Composition) is retrieved.
        Returns:
        The name of the component or the top level composition type (in case of an top level delegation port).

        The MISwComponentPrototype or MICompositionSwComponentType, never null.

      • isCompleted

        @PublishedMethod
boolean isCompleted()
        An IOriginComponentPort is completed if an only if all of its flat extract ports and additionally all of the delegation ports which are connected to these flat extract ports are completed. (See IComponentPort for definition of completed state for flat extract ports.)
        Returns:
        true if this origin component port is completed according to the definition above, false otherwise.

      • isInnerTopLevelDelegationPort

        @PublishedMethod
boolean isInnerTopLevelDelegationPort()
        Method to determine whether the port is directly inside the top level composition (ECU Composition). That means the component owning this port is instantiated inside the top level composition (ECU Composition).
        Returns:
        True if the port is an inner top level delegation port, false otherwise. That means also false for all ports of atomic SWCs.

      • isNestedDelegationPort

        @PublishedMethod
boolean isNestedDelegationPort()
        Returns:
        True if the port is a nested delegation port, false otherwise. Nested delegation ports are all delegation ports, except the ports of the top level composition (ECU Composition). That means all of the inner top level delegation ports are also nested delegation ports.

      • isTopLevelDelegationPort

        @PublishedMethod
boolean isTopLevelDelegationPort()
        Returns:
        True if the port is an outer top level delegation port or in other words, the port of the top level composition (ECU Composition).
